name: Front
summary: Customer communication platform built on shared inboxes across email, SMS and chat. For agents: a hosted MCP server at mcp.frontapp.com/mcp (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, no Dynamic Client Registration) reachable either as a human teammate (official Claude/ChatGPT directory, or a custom confidential OAuth app) or as the AI agent's own identity (a client-credentials token). Its create_draft tool queues a reply for human review without sending, beside read tools for the conversation. Front's own AI-agents guide puts the reply-writing in an externally hosted assistant, not Front.

payments.notes: front.com/pricing FAQ: pay by credit card; wire transfer or ACH only for annual purchases over $12K total contract value (via billing@front.com). The 14-day trial needs no card. Seat prices render behind script not pinned here. Not machine-payable; the docs name no separate MCP charge.

agentAccess.notes: Keyless initialize POST to mcp.frontapp.com/mcp answered 401 (2026-11-13 06:08Z); no Dynamic Client Registration. Two routes: a human teammate's token (official directory, or a custom confidential OAuth app), or a client-credentials token scoped to the AI agent's identity. No tool called.

jobs.summary: create_draft: "Creates a draft reply on an existing conversation, or a new outbound conversation. Does not send." The AI-agents guide puts the reply-writing in an agent "hosted external to Front". Edit distance, handle time and CSAT: no vendor figure.
